title: BLACKVAULT
description: BLACKVAULT is the archive where NEXUS keeps what it does not want to explain. The dead drop gave you a key.
goal: Breach BLACKVAULT and retrieve the backup manifest.
hint: scan first, then 'firewall', then login with the credentials from package.dat.
story_start: MIRA: "BLACKVAULT is rated HIGH. Its firewall will fight back — every wrong guess raises your trace alert."
MIRA: "The package gave you a service account. Use it quietly."

objectives.hint: Type: firewall — then deduce the symbol combination.
login svc_backup  (the password is the decoded passphrase from package.dat)
Type: download manifest.txt  (while connected to BLACKVAULT, from /srv/db or with the full path)

story_end: Fourteen operator profiles, 'ABSORBED'. One 'RESET x3'. This was never a backup vault.

messages.text: Fourteen operators... I need time to look into this. Don't tell anyone else, {player}. Not yet.
Heard you cracked the vault, kid. GHOSTNET. Come find me. Bring questions, not friends.
